results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

record.narrative: No assessments are due in this explore stage. The central active lead is H38, the accepted dataset-specific association between feature_042 and stronger outcome_014 dependency. I therefore registered targeted follow-up comparisons to ask three separate scientific questions: whether the association is outcome-specific, whether it is stable across biologically or statistically relevant measured strata, and whether feature_042 is unusually strong relative to similarly measurable binary predictors. For outcome specificity, H49 and H50 test feature_042 against outcome_016 and outcome_004, using hypothesis direction -1 because an effect in the same direction as H38 would mean feature_042=1 is associated with more negative dependency scores. The 10%-scale absolute references are approximately 0.0256 for outcome_016 and 0.0255 for outcome_004, so an above-threshold cross-outcome effect would indicate a broader association, whereas near-null or attenuated results would keep H38 narrow. For effect modification, H51 and H52 test interactions of feature_042 with median-split feature_043 and with feature_045. These are not new main-effect claims; they ask whether the accepted association is concentrated, diluted, or reversed within subgroups defined by other common measured predictors. Anticipated direction for the interaction contrasts is uncertain because the existing evidence does not motivate a specific modifier. For calibration and breadth, I registered several previously untested binary predictors with adequate exposure prevalence on low- and moderate-threshold outcomes: outcome_014 with feature_007, feature_014, and feature_029; outcome_006 with feature_006 and feature_062; and outcome_012 with feature_011 and feature_005. These controls help decide whether H38 is a distinctive signal or one of many large post-hoc estimates. All proposals remain dataset-specific associations; no causal or external generalization is claimed, and no validation is requested because these comparisons have no direct evidence yet.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

expectation

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

record.narrative:
I assessed all newly delivered discovery results. All estimates are already signed to the hypothesis direction, so positive values support feature_042=1 being associated with more negative dependency scores.

For the accepted H38 feature_042/outcome_014 association, the feature_018 subgroup results are broadly consistent but individually imprecise. H42 gives +0.0411 with interval -0.0110 to +0.0931, and H43 gives +0.0287 with interval -0.0222 to +0.0795. Both point estimates exceed the approximate outcome_014 10%-scale reference of 0.0093 and have the same sign as H38, but each interval is compatible with zero and even with a meaningful opposite subgroup effect. The interaction H44 is small and imprecise, +0.0124 with interval -0.0602 to +0.0851, providing no evidence that feature_018 modifies the effect. Therefore I keep H42 and H43 unresolved but deferred, and H44 deferred: they are useful localization evidence, not independently precise subgroup claims.

The cross-outcome checks mostly support outcome specificity. H46 for outcome_012 gives -0.0122 with interval -0.0310 to +0.0066; H49 for outcome_016 gives -0.0040 with interval -0.0223 to +0.0142; H50 for outcome_004 gives +0.0024 with interval -0.0169 to +0.0218. For these three outcomes, the upper bound of the signed interval is below the corresponding approximate 10% threshold, so the evidence does not support a clinically meaningful feature_042 effect in the registered direction. I reject and close H46, H49, and H50. These are negative evidence for feature_042 association on those outcomes, not proof of no opposite effect.

The important new signal is H47, feature_042 on outcome_006. It has a signed estimate of +0.0534, roughly three times the approximate outcome_006 threshold of 0.0175, and its 95% interval is entirely positive, +0.0114 to +0.0954. This is the only cross-outcome result that supports a clinically meaningful association in the same direction as H38. Because it arose among multiple outcome-specific follow-up tests, I do not accept it immediately; I leave H47 unresolved but active and request independent validation. Validation will test reproducibility under multiplicity-adjusted intervals, not causality or external generalizability.

H45 and H48 cannot be evaluated as written because feature_042=1 has zero observations within feature_009 level_003, yielding invalid comparisons. This is not evidence of no effect within that stratum; it reveals a structural non-overlap between feature_042 and feature_009 level_003. This raises a confounding/proxy concern: feature_042 may partly encode membership in the complement of feature_009 level_003, and any feature_009-related association could be unadjusted. Since the specified stratification is impossible, I leave H45 and H48 unresolved but close the investigations for these exact claims.

The interaction checks H51 and H52 are imprecise and point in the opposite signed direction: -0.0367 and -0.0203, with wide intervals that include both no effect and meaningful effects in either direction. They do not support a clinically meaningful positive interaction in the registered direction, but the intervals are too wide to reject effect modification definitively. I keep them unresolved but closed because they are not promising follow-up targets.

H53 is a calibration control for feature_007/outcome_014. The point estimate is opposite direction, -0.0233, with interval -0.0789 to +0.0323. It does not support a clinically meaningful feature_007 association in the registered direction, but the interval is wide enough to keep scientific uncertainty; I leave it unresolved and close it as uninformative. Overall, the best current lead remains feature_042 with outcome_014, already validated. H47 is the only new candidate worth independent validation.

record.narrative:
The new validation evidence refines the current scientific picture. The only robust supported finding remains H38: in this supplied dataset, feature_042=1 is associated with a stronger outcome_014 dependency score, i.e., a more negative score relative to feature_042=0. That conclusion is supported by both discovery and validation: discovery R34 was +0.0351 with interval -0.0012 to +0.0714, and validation R38 was +0.0502 with interval -0.0030 to +0.1035. Both point estimates are many times the approximate outcome_014 10%-scale reference of about 0.0093, and the intervals, while technically touching negative values at their extremes, are overwhelmingly concentrated on clinically meaningful positive signed effects. I interpret this as a dataset-specific association, not causation and not necessarily external generalizability.

The response deadline for H47 now supports rejecting the claim that feature_042 also has a clinically meaningful association with outcome_006. The hypothesis direction is -1, so signed positive values support stronger outcome_006 dependency for feature_042=1. Discovery R45 was large and positive, +0.0534 with interval +0.0114 to +0.0954, but it arose as a post-hoc cross-outcome follow-up. The independent validation R52 was much smaller, +0.0116, which is below the approximate outcome_006 10%-scale reference of about 0.0175, and its multiplicity-adjusted interval was wide, -0.0460 to +0.0692. The direction is consistent, but the clinically meaningful magnitude did not replicate. Given the discovery context of many follow-up tests, I reject H47 and close it: the current evidence does not support extending feature_042 from outcome_014 to outcome_006. This is not proof of an exact null effect, but it means H47 should not remain an active lead and should not dilute the narrower feature_042/outcome_014 finding.

The response deadline for H20 leaves a smaller and more ambiguous feature_002 signal in lower feature_018 for outcome_006. Discovery R19 was positive, +0.0374 with interval -0.0110 to +0.0859, above the outcome_006 threshold in point estimate but not statistically decisive. Validation R25 was also positive, +0.0188, barely near the 0.0175 threshold, but the interval was very wide, -0.0568 to +0.0944. The direction is same-signed across discovery and validation, yet the precision is too poor and the validation interval does not convincingly establish a clinically meaningful effect. I keep H20 unresolved but defer it rather than close it, because it is the least implausible feature_002 remnant. I do not make it active because the broader feature_002 lead has repeatedly failed validation or threshold across other outcomes and subgroups, including H14, H13, H33, H34, H26, H15, and H16.

The supported findings are therefore narrow. H38 remains accepted as a dataset-specific feature_042/outcome_014 association. The negative or unsupported findings include: H46, H49, and H50, which reject feature_042 effects on outcome_012, outcome_016, and outcome_004 because their signed intervals are not above their approximate 10%-scale references; H47, now rejected for outcome_006 because validation did not replicate a clinically meaningful effect; H14, rejected because validation of feature_002/outcome_011 was far below threshold; and the previously closed feature_045/outcome_012 and feature_045/outcome_014 leads, which were too imprecise or clinically incoherent after localization. Several early predictors were also rejected as null or nonmeaningful in their registered directions: H1, H4-H8, H9, H10, H16, H40, and related feature_002 follow-ups.

record.narrative: No assessments are due. I will analyze twelve previously registered, untested comparisons. The first ten are the newly registered follow-ups to the accepted H38 feature_042/outcome_014 association. H60 and H61 estimate the feature_042 main difference within the higher and lower halves of feature_043, respectively; these are preferable to relying only on the earlier feature_043 interaction because they give direct subgroup main-effect sizes. H62 and H63 do the same within feature_045=1 and feature_045=0, allowing a cleaner test of whether the accepted association is concentrated, diluted, or reversed by feature_045. H64 completes the focused feature_042 outcome-specificity panel by testing outcome_007. H65 asks a structural proxy question: whether feature_009 level_002 differs from the common level_003 on outcome_014, given that feature_042=1 had zero overlap with feature_009 level_003 and may partially encode non-level_003 structure. H66 through H69 are calibration controls with reasonably feasible cell sizes: feature_054 level_002 versus level_001 on outcome_014 and outcome_006, and feature_027 and feature_012 on outcome_014. The final two selected claims, H30 and H31, are high-prevalence outcome_006 calibration controls: feature_034 and feature_045 versus outcome_006. No validation is requested because all selected claims lack direct evidence.

record.narrative: All estimates are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction; for these direction -1 comparisons, a positive estimate means the exposed group has a stronger, more negative dependency score. The approximate outcome_014 clinical-scale reference is about 0.0093 and outcome_006 about 0.0175; outcome_007 about 0.0245. H61 is the most informative new result: in the lower feature_043 subgroup, feature_042=1 versus 0 on outcome_014 gives +0.0534, interval +0.0036 to +0.1033, many times the outcome_014 scale and excluding zero. Because this is a subgroup localization of the already accepted H38 main effect and subgroup tests are numerous, I do not accept it immediately; I leave it unresolved but active and request independent validation. H60 and H63 are same-signed and above the threshold in point estimate but imprecise: H60 +0.0167 [-0.0364, +0.0698] in high feature_043, H63 +0.0407 [-0.0006, +0.0821] in feature_045=0. They suggest the H38 effect may be stronger in lower feature_043 and feature_045=0, but they do not independently establish localization. H62 is positive in point estimate but very imprecise in the small feature_045=1 subgroup. H64 gives feature_042=1 versus 0 on outcome_007 +0.0195 [+0.0010, +0.0380]; it is statistically positive but the point estimate is below the outcome_007 clinical-scale reference, so I defer it rather than accept a new outcome association. H65 is invalid because feature_009 level_002 has only 13 observations; this leaves the feature_042 proxy concern unresolved rather than disproving it. H68 is important but against the registered direction: feature_027=1 versus 0 on outcome_014 gives a very large opposite signed estimate -0.7961 [-0.8163, -0.7759]. Therefore the registered stronger-dependency claim is rejected, but this enormous opposite association warrants a separate reversed or specificity investigation, not validation of the current claim. H66, H67, H69, H30, and H31 are calibration controls with intervals wide enough to remain compatible with clinically meaningful positive effects despite unfavorable point estimates, so they remain unresolved but closed or deferred as uninformative for now. Overall, H38 remains the central supported dataset-specific association, with H61 as the most promising localization candidate.

record.narrative:
The response deadline for H38 strengthens, but does not overturn, the current accepted dataset-specific finding: feature_042=1 is associated with a stronger outcome_014 dependency score than feature_042=0. Both discovery R34 (+0.0351) and validation R38 (+0.0502) are many times the approximate outcome_014 clinical-scale reference near 0.0093. The validation interval still includes a small negative region because of multiplicity and limited precision, but its point estimate and most of its interval are concentrated on clinically meaningful positive signed effects. I therefore keep H38 accepted and active as the central association, with the usual caution that this is an association in the supplied dataset rather than a causal or externally generalizable claim.

The response deadline for H14 rejects the feature_002/outcome_011 positive-dependency lead. Discovery R13 was opposite signed, and independent validation R39 was only +0.0109, below the approximate outcome_011 clinical-scale reference and imprecise. The signs are also inconsistent across discovery and validation. This does not prove an exact null, but it provides no support for a clinically meaningful feature_002 effect on outcome_011.

The new validation of H61 changes the localization story. The discovery subgroup estimate in lower feature_043 was positive and precise-looking, +0.0534, but validation R65 was opposite signed, -0.0397, with a wide multiplicity-adjusted interval that also remains compatible with a positive clinically meaningful effect. Thus, I do not accept H61. The exact claim that feature_042's effect is localized to lower feature_043 remains unresolved and deferred because validation is too imprecise to establish the opposite localization, but it is no longer an active lead. This failure means H38 should initially be described as a main outcome_014 association rather than a confirmed feature_043-dependent subgroup effect.

I also reassessed feature_060/outcome_014 claims H3 and H11 as closed but unresolved: they are low-magnitude and imprecise. The feature_042 localization claims H60 and H63 remain deferred because they are same-signed but individually imprecise; the failed validation of H61 makes me cautious about overinterpreting these subgroup patterns.

The most important unresolved signal is H68. Its registered direction was rejected because the observed signed effect was large and opposite: feature_027=1 is associated with a much less negative outcome_014 score than feature_027=0, i.e. weaker dependency, by about 0.80 in raw scale. This is far above clinical-scale references for outcome_014. I therefore propose a reversed feature_027/outcome_014 claim to test this as its own dataset-specific association, and I propose cross-outcome specificity checks on outcome_006, outcome_007, and outcome_001. If feature_027 has a similar direction on other outcomes, it may reflect a broad measured structure, leakage, or a global outcome scale artifact. If the effect is confined to outcome_014, it is a strong outcome-specific association and may deserve different follow-up than the feature_042 lead.

Finally, because H61 failed replication while H63 suggested a positive feature_042 effect in feature_045=0, I propose one narrow second-order subgroup check: feature_042/outcome_014 within lower feature_043 and feature_045=0. This is exploratory and not a substitute for the accepted H38 main effect, but it tests whether the feature_042 effect may be concentrated in a smaller clinically meaningful subgroup after the failed low-feature_043 validation.

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without

only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.

Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

expectation

If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

status (accept/reject/unresolved),

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative: No assessments are due. The central robust finding is H70: feature_027=1 is associated with a much higher, less negative outcome_014 score, i.e. weaker measured dependency, about +0.80 in discovery and +0.81 in independent validation. The next scientific problem is not whether feature_027 is associated with outcome_014 in this dataset, but what kind of association it is. Because H80 shows the effect is nearly unchanged within feature_042=0, and H78 is near null within feature_027=0, the accepted marginal feature_042/outcome_014 signal may be largely compositional or proxy-related. I therefore register complementary interaction probes of feature_027 by feature_042, by feature_009 level_003, and by feature_009 level_001. These test whether the enormous feature_027 effect is attenuated or amplified inside the strata implicated in earlier feature_042/feature_009 proxy concerns. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response

For the feature_027 claims with direction +1 on outcome_014, a positive mean_difference means feature_027=1 has a higher, less negative dependency score than feature_027=0, i.e. weaker measured dependency. The approximate 10% scale for outcome_014 is near 0.0093, based on the absolute global mean. H107-H112 give direct feature_027 effects of +0.788 to +0.799 with tight confidence intervals, all far above that threshold and based on valid cells. I accept these as stable dataset-specific subgroup estimates: the huge outcome_014 association is not concentrated only in feature_043 high/low, feature_018 high/low, feature_061 high, or feature_010 nonnegative strata. The corresponding feature_061 and feature_010 positive interaction contrasts, H100 and H113, are small and opposite to the registered positive direction, so I reject those specific positive-interaction claims. This does not prove exact absence of effect modification in the opposite direction, but it does not support clinically meaningful positive heterogeneity by those measured variables. For outcome specificity, H105 gives feature_027 on outcome_013 within feature_009 level_003: +0.0365 [0.0102, 0.0627]. This exceeds the approximate outcome_013 10% scale near 0.0269, but its lower bound is below that threshold and the multiplicity is substantial, so I keep it unresolved and request independent validation. H106 gives outcome_006 within feature_009 level_003: +0.0319 [-0.0186, 0.0824], which includes the null and is weaker/less interpretable, so it is unresolved and deferred. The conditional feature_009 contrasts within feature_027 strata, H114 and H115, have near-zero estimates opposite the registered negative direction and no clear residual negative feature_009 signal; H115 additionally has a sparse feature_027=1/level_001 cell. I close these without accepting the negative-direction claims. Overall, the dominant robust conclusion remains a very large, dataset-specific feature_027/outcome_014 weaker-dependency association, robust across many measured covariate strata, with a possible but unconfirmed secondary feature_027 effect on outcome_013. No causal or externally generalizable interpretation is warranted.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;

record.narrative: All estimates are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction. For the feature_027 outcome_014 claims, a positive signed mean_difference means feature_027=1 has a higher, less negative CRISPR dependency score than feature_027=0, i.e. weaker measured dependency in this dataset. The central supported finding remains robust after the response deadline: H70 gives discovery +0.796 [0.776, 0.816] and independent validation +0.810 [0.780, 0.839], far exceeding the approximate outcome_014 10% scale near 0.0093. Together with accepted H80, H84, H95, H107-H112, this is a very strong dataset-specific association or stratification structure, not evidence for causality or external generalizability. The new validation results substantially demote the secondary feature_027 claims. H105, the strongest prior secondary candidate, tested feature_027 on outcome_013 within feature_009 level_003; discovery was positive at +0.0365 [0.0102, 0.0627], but independent validation is opposite and imprecise at -0.0241 [-0.0670, 0.0189], with an adjusted interval that includes the null and crosses the approximate outcome_013 10% scale near 0.0269. I therefore reject H105 and close it. This does not prove exact absence of any outcome_013 heterogeneity, but it does not support treating the borderline overall outcome_013 association as validated. H83 tested feature_009 level_004 versus level_003 on outcome_014 in the negative-dependency direction. The sparse discovery was positive but wide, +0.078 [-0.043, 0.200], and validation is opposite, imprecise, and below threshold in the opposite signed direction, -0.010 [-0.244, 0.223]. I reject and close H83; the small sample makes it uninformative rather than definitive. H13 is a response deadline for feature_002 on outcome_001 in the negative-dependency direction. Validation is +0.035 [-0.012, 0.083], below the approximate outcome_001 10% scale near 0.0415 and imprecise around the null, while discovery was near null. I reject and close it. Current scientific summary: the supplied dataset supports one dominant measured predictor association: feature_027=1 versus 0 is associated with much weaker outcome_014 dependency, robust overall, after validation, and across major measured covariate strata. It is highly outcome-specific in this dataset. Negative or rejected findings include the broad feature_027 effects for most other outcomes, the failed feature_042 low-feature_043 lead, feature_042 versus outcome_006, feature_009 level_004 versus level_003, the secondary outcome_013 level_003 lead, and the feature_002 outcome_001 deadline. Unresolved uncertainty remains mainly around weak borderline secondary outcomes, especially overall outcome_013 and outcome_006 with feature_027, and around the accepted but demoted unadjusted feature_042 outcome_014 association. The most informative next analyses are direct complementary strata for these borderline secondary outcomes and the sparse feature_009 level_001 feature_027 outcome_013 estimate, not further validation of failed leads. Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are

expectation

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short

comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

record.narrative: The main supported finding remains that feature_027=1 versus 0 is associated with much weaker outcome_014 dependency in the supplied dataset. Because the central secondary feature_027/outcome_013 claim failed independent validation and the secondary outcome_006 lead remains borderline, the most informative next science is to ask whether any other measured predictor has a clinically meaningful association after removing the dominant feature_027 stratification. I therefore register residual tests restricted to feature_027=0, where the feature_027-associated stratum is absent. For these registered contrasts, direction -1 encodes the hypothesis that the exposed level is associated with stronger dependency, i.e. a lower score; a positive signed estimate after signing would support that hypothesis. The approximate 10% absolute-mean thresholds are about 0.0093 for outcome_014, 0.0269 for outcome_013, 0.0175 for outcome_006, and 0.0245 for outcome_007, so residual estimates should be judged against both the threshold and the wider uncertainty caused by restricting to feature_027=0. The new residual categorical probes target common levels of feature_048, feature_054, feature_055, and feature_063 that have not already been tested within feature_027=0 or are complementary to active residual tests. Plausible alternatives include true residual nullity, a strong residual signal indicating an independent measured predictor, or a subthreshold/opposite sign due to compositional confounding. I also register residual feature_042 tests on outcome_006, outcome_007, and outcome_013 because feature_042 had earlier marginal signals on some dependency outcomes, while the feature_027=0 feature_014 test for feature_042 was near null. These direct within-stratum mean differences are preferred over interactions because they ask whether feature_042 retains an association in the largest complement to the dominant predictor and help distinguish direct measured associations from relationships mediated or confounded by feature_027. I defer the marginal unadjusted categorical tests H123-H125 and sparse/less focused residual claims H130 and H134 so that later analysis can prioritize these more interpretable residual and feature_042-refinement contrasts. All proposed effects remain dataset-specific associations, not causal or externally generalizable biology.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.
